description: This file contains utility functions for image editing, including parameter filtering, content type detection, and handling external dependencies related to image processing within the litellm project.

classes.name: ImageEditRequestUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling image edit parameters and content type detection.

methods.name: get_optional_params_image_edit
methods.description: Generates a dictionary of supported image edit parameters, filtering unsupported ones based on configuration and flags.

methods.name: get_requested_image_edit_optional_param
methods.description: Filters input parameters to include only those defined in ImageEditOptionalRequestParams.

methods.name: get_image_content_type
methods.description: Detects the MIME type of image data by analyzing the initial bytes, using existing utils.
